applies_to: DATETIME->TIMESTAMP_NTZ, only columns the target recomputes (DATEADD/arithmetic) at ms or us precision

params.grid_note: rounds to a 10 ms grid, so distinct source values .000/.003 and .007/.010/.013 compare equal; record in the tolerance record. Loaded DATETIME columns use identity (1/300 s values are exact in TIMESTAMP_NTZ). Exact fit is GAP datetime_tolerance_ms (|delta| <= 2 ms)

applies_to: DATETIMEOFFSET(p<=3)->TIMESTAMP (UTC-normalise; ms truncation is lossless at p<=3)

params.precision_note: never for DATETIME2/BIGDATETIME/TIME or DATETIMEOFFSET(p>3): truncating to ms hides valid us differences; those use identity, with DATETIME2(7)/DATETIMEOFFSET(7) extracted at us in the source query (GAP datetime_truncate_us)

params.enabled_if: census reports a *_CI_* database/column collation (sys.databases.collation_name, sys.columns.collation_name) or an SSIS no-cache Lookup on a CI database; disabled for Sybase ASE binary sort order (sp_helpsort)

applies_to: only columns the target recomputes from MONEY/SMALLMONEY -> DECIMAL(19,4)/(10,4) (source rounds every MONEY operation to 4 places)

params.places_note: never list this rule on a DECIMAL/NUMERIC(p,s) field or a loaded MONEY field: those are identity (exact at any scale; a recomputed DECIMAL column is cast to DECIMAL(p,s) in the converted SQL). One params set per rule name (recon.canon.Canonicalizer indexes by rule), so a per-scale places is GAP decimal_round_per_field

applies_to: *; DECIMAL/NUMERIC(p,s) at any scale, loaded MONEY, loaded DATETIME, SMALLDATETIME, DATETIME2(p<=6), BIGDATETIME, TIME(p<=6) compare exactly
